ui.preconditions: Signed-out visitor or controlled identity-provider state; backing data Keycloak OIDC sign-in; local demo owner in local-demo mode.

Check the page-specific heading and primary control and confirm no private data is exposed to the wrong account.

bdd.scenario: Sign in: an owner selects secure sign-in
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When an owner selects secure sign-in
bdd.then: Then the browser starts the configured Keycloak OIDC flow
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC sign-in; local demo owner in local-demo mode and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign in: a local demo owner selects continue
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a local demo owner selects continue
bdd.then: Then the local demo workspace opens without requesting a password
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC sign-in; local demo owner in local-demo mode and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign in: a visitor selects forgot password
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.when: When a visitor selects forgot password
bdd.then: Then the configured identity-provider reset flow opens
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC sign-in; local demo owner in local-demo mode and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.

bdd.scenario: Sign in: a visitor selects sign-up
bdd.given: Given a visitor is on the Nexora account lifecycle
bdd.then: Then the configured identity-provider registration flow opens
bdd.and: And the result is consistent with Keycloak OIDC sign-in; local demo owner in local-demo mode and the configured identity/session state
bdd.testData: Use the configured test identity only; do not use real customer credentials.
